lines: Ghalib ke ye dil-khasta shab-e-hijr mein mar jaaye
couplets.en: This battered heart may die in the night of parting.

lines: Ye raat nahin woh jo kahani mein guzar jaaye
couplets.en: This is no night a story can while away.

lines: Ne but-kada hai manzil-e-maqsood na Kaaba
